name: MonarchSlaIndicator
title: SlaIndicator
summary: A service-level target at a glance: on track, at risk, breached, paused, met or not applicable, with the time left or overdue, as a chip or as text.
whenToUse: In a ticket row, a ticket header or a side panel, to show whether a response or resolution target will be met and how much time is left.
whenNotToUse: For a status without a deadline use MonarchBadge. For a running timer of elapsed time use MonarchTabularNumber with the app's own clock.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSlaIndicator(state: MonarchSlaIndicatorState, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchSlaIndicatorVariant = MonarchSlaIndicatorVariant.Chip, dueAt: Long? = null, warnBeforeMillis: Long? = null, earlierBreach: Boolean = false, showNotApplicable: Boolean = false, live: Boolean = true, announceChanges: Boolean = false, now: Long? = null, target: String? = null, icon: (@Composable (MonarchSlaIndicatorState) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSlaIndicatorLabels = MonarchSlaIndicatorLabels(), onStateChange: ((MonarchSlaIndicatorState) -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchSlaIndicatorState { OnTrack, AtRisk, Breached, Paused, Met, NotApplicable }

class MonarchSlaIndicatorLabels(onTrack: String? = null, atRisk: String? = null, breached: String? = null, paused: String? = null, met: String? = null, notApplicable: String? = null, notApplicableMark: String? = null, remaining: ((String) -> String)? = null, overdue: ((String) -> String)? = null, duration: ((Long) -> String)? = null, due: ((String) -> String)? = null, earlierBreach: String? = null, changed: ((String, String?) -> String)? = null)

options.name: state
options.description: The state the server reported. A running state (OnTrack, AtRisk) is derived again from dueAt and the clock.

options.name: variant
options.description: Chip is a compact rounded rectangle; Text is an icon and text without a surface.

options.name: dueAt
options.description: When the target is due, in epoch milliseconds. It drives the countdown ("2h 15m left") and the overdue time ("Overdue 40m").

options.name: warnBeforeMillis
options.description: Turns an on-track target at risk once it is due within this many milliseconds. By default the state is trusted.

options.name: earlierBreach
options.description: An earlier target of the same item was breached. TalkBack says so.

options.name: showNotApplicable
options.description: Writes a missing target as "No SLA" and not as a dash.

options.name: live
options.description: Whether a running target with a due time follows the clock by itself.

options.name: announceChanges
options.description: Announces a change of the shown state through a polite live region. For one prominent indicator, not for every row of a list.

options.name: now
options.description: A fixed reference time in epoch milliseconds, which also stops the clock.

options.name: target
options.description: The name of the target, such as "First response". Read by TalkBack, not shown.

options.name: icon
options.description: Draws the icon of a state in the content color, for example a clock, an exclamation mark, a pause or a check. Monarch bundles no icons. Not drawn for NotApplicable.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings (monarch_slaindicator_*) and the duration format.

options.name: onStateChange
options.description: Called when the shown state changes after the indicator appeared, such as when a countdown runs out.

states.name: OnTrack
states.description: Muted text, no fill. Shows the time left when dueAt is given.

states.name: AtRisk
states.description: Warning colors; the chip has the warning subtle fill and a warning border. Shows the time left.

states.name: Breached
states.description: The chip is solid danger; the text variant is danger-coloured text. Shows the time overdue when dueAt has passed.

states.name: Paused
states.description: Muted text; the chip has the muted fill. No countdown.

states.name: NotApplicable
states.description: No icon, subtle text in the regular weight: a dash, or "No SLA" with showNotApplicable.

appearance: Text in the caption role with tabular digits. The chip has 6dp corners; at risk uses the warning subtle fill, strong text and border, breached the danger solid fill with its on-solid text, paused the muted background. The text variant only colors the text: muted, warning strong, danger strong, success strong or subtle. All roles follow light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map named MonarchBadge with a countdown. The badge has no border on a tinted fill, no transparent form and a capsule shape, so the indicator draws its own chip from the same roles, as iOS does. The web state none is NotApplicable, as on iOS. The web shows the due date in a tooltip; Android reads it in the state description. The web's icons are built in; Monarch bundles no icons, so the icon is an optional slot that receives the state, and every state has its own text. The web live interval and locale options are not offered: the clock wakes at each whole minute and at the at-risk and due edges, and durations use ICU MeasureFormat in the locale of the configuration. The web file also exports SlaTargetList; on Android that is rows of text and the Text variant (see the last example).
accessibility: One TalkBack element. Its content description is the target name and the time left or overdue in words ("First response, 2 hours, 15 minutes left"), or the state name when there is no countdown.
Its state description is the state name when the description is a countdown, then "due" and the date and time, then a note when an earlier target was breached.
Every state has its own text, so the state does not depend on color or on the icon.
With announceChanges a change of the shown state is announced once through a polite live region, such as "First response: Breached".
The text grows with the font size setting and wraps.
edgeCases: A running target whose due time has passed is shown as breached even if the server still reports on track.

Durations are whole minutes rounded down, in at most two units: "<1m", "45m", "2h 15m", "3d 4h". Units come from ICU MeasureFormat in the configuration's locale (narrow for the text, words for TalkBack); only the under-a-minute strings come from the resources.
A breached target without a due time, or with one in the future, shows "Breached".
Paused, Met, Breached and NotApplicable are never changed by the clock, and their indicators do not tick.
With now set, or live false, the text is computed for each composition and does not advance by itself.
onStateChange and the announcement fire for a change of the shown state, whether the clock or a new state value caused it. The first state is not reported.
